crossRefs.note: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given…
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person…

translations.web: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.
translations.bsb: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
translations.kjv: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
translations.asv: and also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my Spirit.
